POLICY (owner lock, quoted in the lane brief): NEVER BELOW COST, AND NEVER FREE AI.
· A DISCOUNT (kind `discount` or `winback`) must leave us, on EVERY rail it is offered on, at least what one
Pro month costs us: `cost.infraUsdPerUserMonth` plus, when the plan carries an AI allowance, that allowance
priced at the dearest candidate model of the AI port (tooling/ports/ai.json). The net is after the rail's
highest commission cell and the highest tax region in tooling/catalog/fee-register.json, the same safe-side
· A FREE month (kind `free-month` or `invite`) carries NO AI allowance: `aiAllowance` is 0, and the grant is a
`promo_code` bundle grant, which the AI meter never counts as paid (src/lib/ai/meter.ts planOf).
tooling/ci/assert-offers.mjs holds both, and every channel of tooling/channel-register.json has a row in `channels`.

infraUsdPerUserMonth.why: DECLARED, not measured: the marginal Workers, D1 and mail cost of one Pro account in a month. No per-account cost has been measured; the figure is set high on purpose (the platform's whole paid Cloudflare plan is a flat monthly fee and one account's reads are far under a cent). The money review replaces it with a measurement and sets basis: measured.

codePolicy.why: A code is 16 characters of a 32-symbol alphabet (80 bits), stored only as its SHA-256. Five redeem attempts per account per minute: the sixth is throttled, so guessing a code by trial is out of reach.

channels.why: Our own site: no store policy. An own code redeems here, and a discount is a Paddle discount on the hosted checkout.
Play requires Play Billing for in-app digital goods, and a code that unlocks them outside Play Billing is the same steering. Codes are Play promo codes, redeemed in the Play Store.

source.quote: Play-distributed apps requiring or accepting payment for access to in-app features or services, including any app functionality, digital content or goods (collectively "in-app purchases"), must use Google Play's billing system for those transactions unless Section 3, 8, or 9 applies.
source.note: The text binds PAYMENT; a free code is not one, and the page read says nothing about promo codes either way. Play promo codes are chosen as the conservative reading, so a Play build never shows our own field; re-decide only on a dated read that permits it.

channels.why: App Store Review Guideline 3.1.1: unlocking content with our own code is a mechanism other than in-app purchase. Codes are App Store offer codes (the system redemption sheet); the build renders NO own-code field.

source.quote: Apps may not use their own mechanisms to unlock content or functionality, such as license keys, augmented reality markers, QR codes, cryptocurrencies and cryptocurrency wallets, etc.
Apps may not use their own mechanisms to unlock content or functionality, such as license keys, augmented reality markers, QR codes, cryptocurrencies and cryptocurrency wallets, etc.

channels.why: Microsoft Store Policies 10.8.1 permit a third-party purchase API for a non-game app; the sale is our own, so our own code is too.
Direct download: no store, no policy.
The Snap Store takes no part in the sale.
Direct download from dl.nikatru.com: no gatekeeper.

Nothing is sold through this storefront (channel-register purchaseRail none), so no discount exists; an own code is a free grant, not a sale, and unlocks the same server entitlement a web purchase would. Whether the Mobile Seva terms allow it is read with the commerce terms (owner queue A-17).
The store cannot take money (Chrome Web Store Payments ended 2021); the sale and the code are our own.
Edge Add-ons has no billing of its own (policy 1.8.1).
AMO is a storefront and a signing service, never a checkout.

offers.why: One free Pro month on an own code (support make-goods, launch codes). No AI allowance: it is a promo_code grant.

activation.why: The invitee has tracked at least one subscription: the SAME moment the app's analytics `activation` event marks (apps/subscriptiontracker/lib/state/analytics_funnel.dart onActivation, kind first_subscription_added) and services/platform/queries/insights/01-activation-rate.sql counts — read here from the account's own rows, because that query's events_daily is keyed on the install id and joining it to an account is the pairing [ADR 020] forbids (tooling/ci/assert-pseudonymity-firewall.mjs).

offers.why: Invite a friend: one free Pro month for BOTH, once the invitee is a real, active, new user. No AI allowance for either.
20% off the first three months, on the rail's own discount mechanism.
A lapsed subscriber's way back: 40% off two months on the web checkout. lifecycle-mail's win-back may carry it.
